answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 37585 Country: India Title: I need some dua for getting halal business or I am thinking to run a business of woods so please tell me amal or dua so I run my business with the help of Allah (SWT) and Allah give me success in my business Question: I need some dua for getting halal business or I am thinking to run a business of woods so please tell me amal or dua so I run my business with the help of Allah (SWT) and Allah give me success in my business. And I want to marry with pious girl, please give me dua for this too. Answer ID: 37585 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 551/552/M=1433) Do your business on halal pattern. Keep yourself away from lying, deception and treason. Run your business with truthfulness and trustworthiness, then in-shaAllah, you shall receive success. Also recite the following dua after each salah: اللهم اكفني بحلالك عن حراملك وأغنني بفضلک عمن سواك . Find out any religious family for marriage. And recite the following dua: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
